notes.title: Set up PS4 controller
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25027130/79f911e611ecf911fc45ad8d4b5d39027cdbf545.png[/img]


[i]*Only PS4 controller users! [/i]

STB support Xbox360, XboxOne pad.
But I know many people use a different controller.
So, I make Input manager, but it seems too complicated.

If you have a PS4 pad, follow this.

[h1][b]● Set up PS4 controller config[/b][/h1] 
First, you will update 1.18 (Auto update)
And you can find PS4 pad config in that folder. 
[h1](Steam install folder)\Steam\steamapps\common\SMASHING THE BATTLE\Pad_Config

Execute STB_PS4pad_Config.reg file. [/h1]

And you can use PS4 pad!

notes.title: STB Update 1.10 !!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/o2I1NjA.png[/img]


[h1][b]Now STB Update 1.10 !![/b][/h1]


Fixed
- STB support Game Launcher.
You can change resolution, window mode, select monitor, remaping keys.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/u4RXP6r.jpg[/img]
It's not cool, but solve a lot of problems  :)

- Controller tutorial visible just 1 stage.
- Some minor bug fixed.
- Japanese font problem fixed.


[h1][b]If you use PS4 pad, please download this file![/b][/h1]
https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B_m74Vw2dbxzNW9KQkRCdl9GNXc
It's my PS4 pad setting file. (STB_PS4pad_Config.reg)
You can double-click and yes, use PS4 pad.

Or you can change key maping in game launcher :)

*If your controller work well, do not install that file.


[h1][b]今PS4 Padをサポートします。[/b][/h1]
このファイルをダウンロードしてください。
https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B_m74Vw2dbxzNW9KQkRCdl9GNXc
STB_PS4pad_Config.regを実行すると、PS4 Padが動作します。
またはLauncherで自分だけのセッティングをしてください。

*もし、すでにうまく動作する場合のインストールしないでください。



[h1][b]And Trading card support NOW! [/b][/h1]

Thank you for waiting!!
